breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses `solidDisplacementFoam` as a separate solid solver (instead of incorrectly reusing `pimpleFoam` for the solid domain). It also specifies two-way FSI coupling using the `solids4foam` library for exchanging displacement and traction between the fluid and solid domains. This matches the ground truth's intent of having a dedicated solid solver and proper interface coupling.
